name: DAMA/LIBRA
full_name: Large sodium Iodide Bulk for RAre processes
summary: DAMA/LIBRA succeeds DAMA/NaI with a larger, lower-background NaI(Tl) array for long-term annual-modulation measurements. Its reported modulation motivates same-target tests by ANAIS, COSINE, SABRE and COSINUS.
detection_principle: Annual variations are fitted in low-energy single-crystal event rates and compared with control samples such as multiple-hit events and higher energies. Scintillation readout does not provide the direct event-by-event nuclear/electron recoil discrimination of cryogenic dual readout.

results.summary: The full same-target COSINE dataset challenges the dark-matter interpretation of DAMA/LIBRA's annual modulation. The DAMA claim must not be described as an established discovery.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
